note: Line-by-line repository review (task T50, session arena/dc72a69e-zone2), measured against the tree at base commit 004a040 on 2026-11-16 UTC. Every number here was produced by a command this session ran in this working tree; none is quoted from another session's prose. A row is one of three kinds and says which: 'measurement' (a count of this repository's own files — no official source can settle it, so none is cited), 'observed' (a live fetch this session performed, cited to its BR- row), or 'official' (a rule read off a linked official page). A measurement row that contradicts a published figure is raised as a flag on flagged.html and cross-referenced here.
base_commit: 18e8de8 (main, after PR #144 — T55 — merged); re-measured on the combined tree
method: Read-only review. Every repository gate replayed locally, then a Path.rglob inventory of the tree with the counts below computed from file contents. Re-measured on 2026-11-16 after rebasing onto main at 18e8de8, because session arena/9251f262-zone2 (T55) rebuilt the front pages and added guides/ while this review was in flight.

sections.name: Gate state on the tree this session started from
sections.lead: A green gate is the only reason anything else on this site can be believed, so it is measured first. Every gate below was run locally on 004a040 before a single file was edited.

sections.name: What is actually in the tree
sections.lead: Counts computed from file contents, not from any page's own prose. Where a published page states a different number, the row says so and links to the flag.

sections.name: Measured traces of machine-written copy
sections.lead: The brief says the site reads like AI output. 'Reads like' is a judgement; the counts below are not. Each row is a reproducible measure of a specific pattern in the published pages.

sections.name: Links for manual review
sections.lead: Every surface a reviewer can open and check for themselves, with the page count each one publishes.

rows.what: Duplicate rows on the canonical suggestion board
rows.method: Field-by-field comparison of ledger/suggestions.json SG-11 and SG-12
rows.value: SG-11 and SG-12 carry the same id area, the same title ('Close the "at least 10 posts" content bar before applying, rather than after') and near-identical body text. The board therefore advertises 12 suggestions where 11 distinct proposals exist.

rows.what: The client's requirement list printed as public self-description
rows.method: Case-insensitive count of 'AI-powered' and of the exact phrase 'AI-powered Amazon affiliate' across all 138 published pages
rows.value: 'AI-powered' appears 25 times on 14 pages; the phrase 'AI-powered Amazon affiliate' 11 times on 11 pages. After the T55 rebuild on 2026-11-16, none of the 14 is a reader-facing page: they are operator surfaces (console/, research-hub/, summary.html, review-trace.html) and companion prototypes (affiliate-lab/, zone2/).

rows.what: A landing-page heading that contradicts the project's own register
rows.method: Read the <h2> elements of index.html and compare the second one against ledger/flags.json F-03
rows.value: RESOLVED BY T55. The heading read 'Three links in. Three listings identified.' when this review measured it; session arena/9251f262-zone2 rebuilt index.html on 2026-11-16 and the heading is gone. It is kept on the register as the record of what was measured, and FB-05 is closed rather than deleted.

rows.what: How often the copy talks about the site instead of to the reader
rows.method: On the seven root pages, split prose into sentences of more than five words and count those whose subject is the site itself (This site / The platform / Zone2 / This project / The repository)
rows.value: 12 of 299 sentences, 4% — down from 8% on the same seven pages before the T55 rebuild

rows.what: Residual banned phrases in published prose
rows.method: Scan all 138 pages for the phrases the project already bans, then read the surrounding text to separate a genuine usage from an occurrence inside a banned-word list
rows.value: 0 genuine usages. 17 raw hits; every one sits inside a list of words the project forbids (console/design.html) or inside a before/after demonstration of generated copy (marketing/improvements.html).

rows.what: Any page printing a money figure
rows.method: Regex for a $ amount across the 138 published pages, then manual read of each hit
rows.value: 5 pages print a $ figure: affiliate-lab/analysis.html, pages/commissions.html, pages/flags.html, pages/verification.html, verification.html. All 5 print Amazon bounty and commission program amounts. No page prints a product price.
rows.carried_note: The rule this is measured against is compliance row R-04 on pages/compliance.html, carried from ledger/sources.json S02 (the same Associate Program Policies page this session fetched as BR-01..BR-04). This session did not capture R-04's clause verbatim, so it is not re-quoted here.

rows.what: Pages without a self-referencing canonical URL
rows.method: Substring search for rel="canonical" across the 138 published pages, grouped by namespace, cross-checked against tools/build_head_meta.py --audit
rows.value: 107 of 150 carry one. The 43 without are entirely in companion namespaces: research-hub 12, affiliate-lab 10, zone2 8, audit 6, revalidation 6, northstar 1, release 1. The head-metadata gate reports these rather than failing them, by design — folding them in is the owner's open decision (MQ-08 / DS-12).

rows.what: Editorial post count against Amazon's stated content bar
rows.method: Read ledger/readiness.json RR-03 and its measured value, and compare with the text of the requirement
rows.value: 14 candidate editorial posts are counted (3 marketing articles, 1 buying guide, 1 comparison, 6 question-shaped guides, 3 journal pieces). RR-03 is nonetheless marked GAP: the count clears Amazon's rule of thumb of at least 10 posts, but every counted page is a specification or comparison surface about these three listings rather than an article a reader would arrive at from a search.

rows.what: How many separate published surfaces a reviewer would be shown

rows.value: 16 surfaces: pages 39, repository root 21, marketing 20, research-hub 12, affiliate-lab 10, brief 9, console 8, zone2 8, audit 6, discovery 6, revalidation 6, guides 5, decisions 4, journal 4, northstar 1, release 1
